title: PassVault
tagline: PassVault is a browser extension built with Inter Planetry File System. Users can use their seed phrase to login their account and view their saved credentials. PassVault was built considering security as the #1 priority and is better than most of the traditional password managin
description:
Most of us use password managers in our day to day internet usage to make sure we don't loose our credentials. But now a days, there is huge risk of your credentials getting compromised because most of the password managers and centralized and the data is stored with a third party.

To put an end to this, we introduce 'PassVault' - a password manager built with IPFS. PassVault is immutable, secure and easy to use.
